title: Window overview
summary: Understand the main areas of the Preview window: Menubar, Sidebar, Canvas, and Markup Toolbar.

sections.heading: Menubar and Top Toolbar
sections.text: The top bar contains traffic light controls, navigation buttons, zoom controls, rotate, markup toggle, search, and inspector.

sections.heading: Sidebar
sections.text: The left sidebar displays Thumbnails, Contact Sheet view, or the Table of Contents outline.

sections.heading: Canvas
sections.text: The central canvas displays document pages or images with smooth panning and zooming.

sections.heading: Markup Toolbar
sections.text: The secondary toolbar below the main bar provides sketch, shapes, text, note, redact, and formatting tools.

steps: Press Ctrl + B to show or hide the sidebar.
Click the Markup button on the top toolbar to reveal the Markup Toolbar.
Use the zoom controls or mouse wheel to adjust canvas magnification.
note: The secondary Markup Toolbar remains hidden until you click the Markup pill button.
